db.title: Databases
db.description: Databases folder of the pipelines: a database missing from it is built (and saved to <output dir>/db). The folder can also be given as a tar archive of it (path or URL), that must hold all the needed databases.

basedir.description: Databases folder, as built by wf/db or the db/ folder of a previous run, or tar archive of it (path or URL)

fasta.description: FASTA files of the assemblies: comma-separated paths, glob patterns or URLs

ont.description: Path to BAM, CRAM or FASTQ.GZ files containing ONT reads (BAM/CRAM are converted to FASTQ)

illumina.description: Path to FASTQ.GZ files containing short reads. Paired-end files are recognized when ending with regex pattern '_(R?[12])(_[0-9][0-9][0-9])?.(fq|fastq).gz$'
